Chapter 1047: 7 Is My Disciple The Great Lord? (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2

Chapter 1047: Chapter 7 Is My Disciple the Great Lord? (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2

“No, we need to inform the master immediately. The failure of this mission wasn’t our fault; it was that cunning Lord Qingfen.”

The gaunt man Kuang Zhen promptly contacted Marquis Purple Dream. The plan targeting Qingfen City originated from the capital of the Ancient Country, and failure would certainly result in punishment.

But was it not mentioned beforehand that another Great Lord was hidden within Qingfen City?

If this information had been known earlier, the Purple Dream Domain would never have implemented the current plan. Dealing with a hidden Great Lord would require comprehensive adjustments to the entire strategy.

…

In front of the Sky Burning Court, time and space condensed, imprisoning all directions like amber.

“This Yu Yan is a Great Lord?”

The purple-haired woman was equally desperate, never expecting that she and her group, who intended to see if they could easily eliminate the future major threat to the Purple Dream Domain, would encounter such a formidable opponent.

And to find out that the other party was a Great Lord?

Were they rulers contemplating dealing with a Great Lord?

Rustle, rustle.

Lin Yuan’s right hand pierced through the void, reaching for her.

This right hand encompassed all time and space. Earlier, many of the purple-haired woman’s fellow disciples had perished under this hand, even the physically strongest gaunt man Kuang Zhen, whose body and soul disintegrated under it.

“Myriad Formation Crystal.”

Under the absolute threat of death, the purple-haired woman ignored everything else and directly brought out the ancient treasure bestowed by the capital of the Ancient Country.

The Myriad Formation Crystal could replicate any Postnatal Array, profoundly mysterious, but it was not merely limited to replicating formations.

Similarly, the Myriad Formation Crystal had other uses; it could activate the formations replicated within it externally.

Of course, the actual power of a formation directly activated in this way was only a tenth or even several tenths of the original formation’s power.

However, it was very convenient, after all, setting up a formation required various materials, and the defensive array of Qingfen City had formed after countless millennia of accumulation.

Yet the Myriad Formation Crystal could directly form a formation; extremely astonishing.

Rumble.

A grand array containing an infinite Spatial-Temporal Maze enveloped the purple-haired woman, and Lin Yuan’s reaching hand directly missed, falling into overlapping time and space, and finally retracted.

“This formation? Interesting.” Lin Yuan observed closely, particularly eyeing the crystal floating before the purple-haired woman.

Lin Yuan could sense that the Spatial-Temporal Grand Array enveloping the purple-haired woman originated from this crystal.

“Great Lord, why stoop to attack an ant like me?” The purple-haired woman’s heart pounded, realizing that the manifested Space-Time Grand Array was already the strongest defensive formation she could activate.

Even so, with Lin Yuan’s previous grasp, she felt a slight tremble in the Space-Time Grand Array.

After all, the purple-haired woman was not the true owner of the Myriad Formation Crystal and could not activate its most potent formations. Even if she were the owner, without reaching the Great Lord or Heavenly Venerable Realm, she wouldn’t be able to activate it.

Despite the Myriad Formation Crystal bypassing numerous material constraints and directly forming a formation, activating the internal formations required at least minimal understanding.

“You took the initiative against me, and I can’t fight back?” Lin Yuan continued to observe the Myriad Formation Crystal.

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to comprehend the source of formations, grasping many of their mysteries.]

With Lin Yuan’s strength, if he truly acted, he could surely break through the Space-Time Grand Array by force and kill the purple-haired woman inside.

But doing so would likely damage the crystal; Lin Yuan, having browsed countless books and inheritances on the thirteenth floor of the Sky Burning Court, knew this crystal should be the Myriad Formation Crystal.

Such a treasure’s value was incalculable. Even if Lin Yuan didn’t use it himself, he could keep it to exchange for the resources he desired.

So he planned to grasp the mysteries of the Space-Time Grand Array activated by the Myriad Formation Crystal slightly and directly bypass the array to kill the purple-haired woman.

This way, the Myriad Formation Crystal remained unharmed, and Lin Yuan would benefit.

“What a pity, the few suppressed souls extinguished themselves entirely.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. A peak Ruler’s mere thought could extinguish their own soul, making it hard for Lin Yuan to prevent it.

“We didn’t know you were here, Great Lord…” Seeing that Lin Yuan didn’t act immediately, the purple-haired woman felt a deep sigh of relief.

As long as he hadn’t attacked, there was room for negotiation.

“I see that you, Great Lord, aren’t a Great Lord of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country. I wonder what price Lord Qingfen offered to have you stationed here? Our Purple Dream Domain is willing to offer double.”

The purple-haired woman spoke up immediately.

She was fully aware of the importance of this plan, as it concerned the beginning of a battlefield between the Ancient Countries. Even when encountering unexpected changes, they still needed to complete it to the best of their ability.

“Are you done speaking?”

At this moment, Lin Yuan had already fully comprehended the Space-Time Grand Array activated by the Myriad Formation Crystal with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding and acted again.

Rumble.

Lin Yuan’s right hand reached out again, probing deep into the intertwining times and spaces.

“Great Lord, you?”

The purple-haired woman’s heart trembled, but seeing the Myriad Formation Crystal in front of her, she calmed herself slightly, “I can’t let this drag on, this way Lord Qingfen might free himself from the master’s means. By then, if two Great Lords join forces, along with Qingfen City’s array…”

The purple-haired woman was contemplating this when she abruptly noticed that Lin Yuan’s extending right hand had not retracted after entering the Space-Time Grand Array, but continued to approach her.

The Space-Time Grand Array encompassed countless overlapping times and spaces, even a Great Lord level strongman might be trapped in it briefly.

But Lin Yuan’s reaching right hand passed through the myriad overlapping times and spaces as if they were nothing, and the Space-Time Grand Array, centered on the Myriad Formation Crystal, seemed as fragile as paper before Lin Yuan’s hand.
